description: Patients qualify if they have a record with a urine protein result of '-' and a record with a rheumatoid factor result of '-'. These can be different records.

b.request: For each patient having at least one laboratory record where U-PRO = '-' and at least one laboratory record where RA = '-' (these records may be different), calculate the average PT and average (TAT - TAT2) across all their laboratory records; then return the average of these per-patient PT averages and the average of these per-patient (TAT - TAT2) averages as two values in a single row, ignoring null values.
b.sql:
WITH filtered_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' OR RA = '-'
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.ID,
    AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt,
    AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) as avg_tat_diff
  FROM filtered_patients fp
  JOIN Laboratory l ON fp.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY fp.ID
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pt) as overall_avg_pt,
  AVG(avg_tat_diff) as overall_avg_tat_diff
FROM patient_averages
b.raw: For each patient having at least one laboratory record where U-PRO = '-' and at least one laboratory record where RA = '-' (these records may be different), calculate the average PT and average (TAT - TAT2) across all their laboratory records; then return the average of these per-patient PT averages and the average of these per-patient (TAT - TAT2) averages as two values in a single row, ignoring null values.

d.request: Select patients with at least one laboratory record having U-PRO = '-' and at least one (possibly different) record having RA = '-'; for each qualifying patient, compute the average PT and average (TAT − TAT2) across all laboratory records, ignoring null values; return the average of per-patient PT averages and the average of per-patient (TAT − TAT2) averages as an unrounded two-value row.
d.sql: WITH qualifying_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-')), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PT) as avg_pt, AVG(TAT - TAT2) as avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qualifying_patients) GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt), AVG(avg_tat_diff) FROM patient_averages;

a.request: Consider patients who have at least one laboratory record with a urine protein (`U-PRO`) result of exactly '-' and at least one laboratory record, not necessarily the same one, with a rheumatoid factor (`RA`) result of exactly '-'. For each such patient, use all of their laboratory records to compute the average prothrombin time (`PT`) and the average of `TAT` minus `TAT2`. Across these patients, what are the average of the per-patient PT averages and the average of the per-patient TAT − TAT2 averages? Give them as a single row with these two values, unrounded, and ignore missing values at every step.
a.sql:
WITH valid_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `U-PRO` = '-'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RA = '-'
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt,
    AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) as avg_tat_diff
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM valid_patients)
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pt) as avg_of_avg_pt,
  AVG(avg_tat_diff) as avg_of_avg_tat_diff
FROM patient_averages

c.request: Consider patients whose laboratory results include a urine protein (`U-PRO`) result of exactly '-' and a rheumatoid factor (`RA`) result of exactly '-'. For each such patient, use all of their laboratory records to compute the average prothrombin time (`PT`) and the average of `TAT` minus `TAT2`. Across these patients, what are the average of the per-patient PT averages and the average of the per-patient TAT − TAT2 averages? Give them as a single row with these two values, unrounded, and ignore missing values at every step. Patients qualify if they have a record with a urine protein result of '-' and a record with a rheumatoid factor result of '-'. These can be different records.
c.sql: WITH qualifying_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT l1.ID FROM Laboratory l1 WHERE l1.`U-PRO` = '-' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l1.ID AND l2.RA = '-')) SELECT AVG(patient_pt_avg) AS avg_pt, AVG(patient_tat_diff_avg) AS avg_tat_diff FROM (SELECT qp.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS patient_pt_avg, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS patient_tat_diff_avg FROM qualifying_patients qp JOIN Laboratory l ON qp.ID = l.ID GROUP BY qp.ID) patient_averages
